rows.en: Touya: "...?"
Leone: "...Nobody's here..."
Ymir: "Touya! Everyone's installing the defensive field's
auxiliary output device.
We're having trouble maintaining output... For now,
we'll have to assign a few mechs to keep it going.
Sorry, Touya, but I need you to choose which mechs will take part in the fighting.
We'll manage the rest here."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Got it."
Ymir: "Touya, Leone, Yamato.
We're about to take Liebhofen inside Vorlia.
The enemy may attack before we get there.
I need you all to work together and protect us somehow."
Touya: "Yeah, understood. And once we're inside, the Spirit Mechs
destroy it from within... Right?"
Ymir: "Yes. It's a reckless plan, but it's our only option."
Touya: "It sure is reckless, but we've got no choice."
Ymir: "Leone, are you all right?"
Leone: "...Y-Yes... I'm all right."
Ymir: "This is what you and Touya chose, so I won't
say anything. But make sure you come back.
You can promise me that, can't you?"
Leone: "...Yes. I'll do my best."
Sisk: "Be careful! On Vorlia's surface,
we're detecting an intense heat source!"
Clovis: "...Looks like we're not welcome after all."
Sisk: "It's coming!"
Sisk: "Huh...? What's going on?"
Derock: "It's almost like it's trying to scare us off.
It didn't come our way, but if something like that hit us,
we'd be done for."
Celica: "Rayfon!"
Rayfon: "We'll manage the defense here."
Rishuna: "Everyone, prepare to enter.
Our mechs can manage as long as all we have to do is defend!"
Touya: "Thanks. Then we should be all right... Okay!"
Valga: "...It may not be quite that simple."
Celica: "Huh? Wh-What... are those...?"
Clovis: "Those ones in the middle... Aren't those Parthenos and
Eleana?!"
Leone: "Huh...?"
Rayfon: "This is bad... It's copied them..."
Touya: "It can do something that ridiculous?!"
Valga: "It is doing it right before our eyes, like it or not.
But that Vorlia is displaying abilities
unknown to us. This is rather troublesome..."
Rayfon: "Don't worry. They're only imitations. Their performance
should be worse than the originals'."
Celica: "Even if it's worse..."
Rayfon: "It seems to have realized what we're planning.
We've got our hands full defending. I'm counting on you."
Celica: "...We'll just have to do it..."
Arthur: "We still have the fighting inside to consider.
Rather than pushing ourselves, how about taking any damaged mechs back to Liebhofen
and bringing them aboard?"
Ymir: "...You're right.
Any mech that reaches 80% damage is to retreat.
We'll make whatever repairs we can
and prepare to enter."
Ai: "Roger. But it'd be no joke
if everyone ended up retreating!"
Kasumi: "Then let's all work together to make sure that doesn't happen, okay?"
Ai: "Well, that's worked for us so far,
so let's finish this in style."
Clovis: "...Touya, Rayblade is our command center, so to speak.
We need you to hold out to the very end. Can you do it?"
Touya: "You can count on me."
Xiujian: "That's the spirit.
...I'd say we have about four minutes until we reach the target point."
Touya: "So we just have to hold them off until then?
All right, let's go!!"
Touya: "...?"
Yamato: "Huh? Nobody's here..."
Miyasco: "Touya! Everyone's installing the defensive field's
auxiliary output device. For now,
we'll have to assign a few mechs to maintain it.
I'm sorry, but please choose which mechs will take part in the fighting.
We'll manage the rest here."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Got it."
Touya: "Hey, wouldn't we be better off
staying in the hangar until we break through?"
Arthur: "True, but we have to consider the worst..."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Clovis: "The bombardment could destroy the hatch,
or the hangar itself could take a hit. Any number of things, right?"
Xiujian: "With us out here like this, more of us
should survive until we get inside."
Fain: "I wouldn't mind falling in a clash of swords, but I'd rather
not be destroyed by cannon fire..."
Sisk: "Be careful! On Vorlia's surface,
we're detecting an intense heat source!"
Clovis: "...Looks like we're not welcome after all."
Sisk: "It's coming!"
Touya: "Ghh... Hold out..."
Sisk: "Huh...? What's going on?"
Derock: "It's almost like it's trying to scare us off.
It didn't come our way, but if something like that hit us,
we'd be done for."
Celica: "Rayfon!"
Rayfon: "We'll manage the defense here."
Rishuna: "Everyone, prepare to enter.
Our mechs can manage as long as all we have to do is defend!"
Touya: "Thanks. Then we should be all right... Okay!"
Valga: "...It may not be quite that simple."
Celica: "Huh? Wh-What... are those...?"
Clovis: "Those ones in the middle... Aren't those Parthenos and
Eleana?!"
Rayfon: "This is bad... It's copied them..."
Touya: "It can do something that ridiculous?!"
Valga: "It is doing it right before our eyes, like it or not.
But that Vorlia is displaying abilities
unknown to us. This is rather troublesome..."
Rayfon: "Don't worry. They're only imitations. Their performance
should be worse than the originals'."
Celica: "Even if it's worse..."
Rayfon: "It seems to have realized what we're planning.
We've got our hands full defending. I'm counting on you."
Celica: "...We'll just have to do it..."
Arthur: "We still have the fighting inside to consider.
Rather than pushing ourselves, how about taking any damaged mechs back to Liebhofen
and bringing them aboard?"
Ymir: "...You're right.
Any mech that reaches 80% damage is to retreat.
We'll make whatever repairs we can
and prepare to enter."
Ai: "Roger. But it'd be no joke
if everyone ended up retreating!"
Kasumi: "Then let's all work together to make sure that doesn't happen, okay?"
Ai: "Well, that's worked for us so far,
so let's finish this in style."
Clovis: "...Touya, Rayblade is our command center, so to speak.
We need you to hold out to the very end. Can you do it?"
Touya: "You can count on me."
Xiujian: "That's the spirit.
...I'd say we have about four minutes until we reach the target point."
Touya: "All right, give the enemy everything we've got.
Protect Liebhofen!"
Yamato: "Three minutes left. Hang in there!"
Yamato: "Two minutes left! Just a little more! We're almost..."
Yamato: "One minute left! One last push! We can do it!"
Sisk: "We've reached the designated point!"
Miyasco: "Output rising! We can do it!"
Touya: "Heh! Maybe I got a little too serious there?"
Yamato: "Oh, honestly! Don't let your guard down!
The real test starts now."
Touya: "Yeah, yeah."
Yamato: "Honestly..."
Sisk: "We've reached the designated point!"
Miyasco: "Output rising! We can do it!"
Sisk: "Second bulkhead damaged! Closing bulkheads!"
Captain Roa: "Hmm...!"
Derock: "Th-This is bad."
Sisk: "Floating Block System damaged!
Third bulkhead wrecked! Sealing off everything up to B Area!"
Miyasco: "If this keeps up..."
Sisk: "The engine section's been hit! We can't take any more!"
Miyasco: "Please, hold together..."
Captain Roa: "U-Urrgh..."
Yamato: "Touya!"
Touya: "Yeah... Two more hits and we're finished.
I won't let them land any more!"
Sisk: "Engine section wrecked!
We won't get the bulkheads closed... in time!"
Miyasco: "Blocks 2, 4, 6 and 7 aren't responding!
N-No! The secondary explosions... Aaaaaah!!"
Clovis: "Sorry, I'm retreating!"
Arthur: "This is as far as I can go...
I'm sorry. I'm counting on you to handle the rest!"
Fain: "Over something this trivial...!"
Touya: "Fain! That's enough! Fall back!"
Fain: "Not yet! I can still fight!"
Touya: "I need you! I can't have you going down now!
Don't push yourself!"
Fain: "You need me...? I-I see.
Heh heh heh... Very well! I'm leaving the rest to you!
Next time, I'll win! Dah hah hah!"
Touya: "..."
Xiujian: "...This is my limit... I'm leaving the rest to you."
Gen: "Ghh... I-I might be in trouble..."
Touya: "Gen, leave the rest to me. Don't push yourself!"
Gen: "Y-Yeah... Okay, big bro. I'm leaving the rest to you."
Ai: "Ugh... I can't believe I let my guard down..."
Touya: "Ai, leave the rest to me."
Ai: "...This is so frustrating... But I guess I've got no choice.
...Okay. I'm counting on you, then!"
Kasumi: "...At this rate... But...!"
Touya: "That's enough! There's no need to push yourself here!"
Kasumi: "Touya... But..."
Touya: "Trust me. I swear I'll protect Liebhofen.
So leave this to me."
Kasumi: "...Okay.
...Touya, be careful."
Celica: "Hmm... With Selphin's armor,
I really was at a disadvantage in a melee like this...
Sorry! I'm counting on you to handle the rest!"
Aurelie: "Aargh, honestly! Maybe defense really
isn't my thing?
...No choice. I'm retreating!"
Melvi: "Huh? Already...?
I'm sorry, Forstin. It's my fault..."
Touya: "Are you all right?"
Melvi: "Y-Yeah... But my poor mech..."
Touya: "Leave this to us and fall back, Melvi."
Melvi: "...Okay.
Big brother, do your best!"
Melissa: "Ah... Is this my limit?"
Touya: "Are you okay?"
Melissa: "Yes...
I'm sorry. I'm counting on you to handle the rest."
